comment: Curated Pāli set phrases that unambiguously determine a word's dictionary entry in the Gloss tab. 'phrase' is the human-readable phrase; the seeder normalizes it with normalize_gloss_context before insert. 'word' is the surface form the rule applies to; 'selected_uid' is the dict_words uid to select. See docs/gloss-ai-word-selection.md.
